scenes.label: Shopify store owners
scenes.vo: Is your Shopify store slow on mobile?

scenes.title: Four usual suspects
items: Full-size photos on a small screen
Each one can add its own scripts
The page waits before it shows
scenes.vo: It's usually four things. Images that are far too big, too many apps, code that old apps left behind, and scripts that make the page wait.

scenes.title: Fixed inside the theme
scenes.caption: Illustrative Shopify Liquid
scenes.vo: We shrink images to the size the screen needs, lazy load the ones below the fold, defer scripts, and clean out code nobody uses.

scenes.title: Then we measure again
scenes.vo: Then we test again on a real phone and in Google's speed test, so you can see what changed.

scenes.sub: Shopify speed work, theme clean-ups and custom sections.
scenes.vo: Shopify feeling sluggish? Request a speed audit from SK Developer on WhatsApp.
